findings.change: Shared pager/allocation handoff always recreates and binds input owner, geometry and terminal control callback; actual post-handoff key dispatch tested across success, nonzero, OSError and interrupt.
Scheduler actions use asynchronous review/execute publication with generation and identity guards. Shared UI tests preserved; explicit mutation yields automatic project discovery.
Python no-op SIGINT/SIGQUIT handlers protect Raven during child foreground handoff while exec restores child default disposition; finally restores handlers/modes/bound reader.
Final text/ANSI/curses paint and cell-raster boundaries normalize untrusted text consistently, including C0/C1, OSC/DCS and format/surrogate controls. Raw logs are retained separately.

Native publication tokens enable document reuse on every standard workspace page; one-second clock/source-age/pending-wait patches and explicit freshness transition avoid idle full composition. Unknown extensions/active readers retain conservative fallback.
Selection/marks no longer invalidate source-row preparation; native immutable publication keys avoid queue field rescans; external snapshots retain exhaustive in-place field correction checks.

Controller input helpers and text/watch paths use render_snapshot, not full time-series history copies; native history sort/projection caches are keyed by publication/filter/sort/group state. Explicit JSON/report exports retain full snapshots.
App binds Store tag/event persistence to existing shared source lane; Store coalesces writes, headless remains synchronous, close drains accepted pending annotations.

Interactive ordinary copies pin immutable selections and queue on shared workers, cap8 pending, poll receipts; clipboard tools share2-second budget. Fixed pending-list replacement race discovered by new regression.
Curses/watch bells use monotonic started_seq rather than counting bounded event deque.
Store prunes live_rate and identity indexes with retained records; see data-owner ledger for exact bounds and evidence.
POSIX SIGWINCH writes directly to selector wake fd; handler only sets resize flag and never acquires Store/UIWakeup locks; previous signal/wakeup state restored.
Bulk pin has one uniform target (pin all unless all already pinned), one retained atomic annotation publication.
Historical capture freezes bounded references/containers under Store lock, then converts/JSON encodes outside publication lock.

Local directory discovery inspects bounded lstat-verified regular user-owned entries, records uid/mode/device/inode/size evidence; local read/stat/copy/bundle sources reject symlink leaves via no-follow descriptors. Remote discovery filters regular uid-owned files.

Redundant leading .* removed before validated regex compilation; highlights operate on visible width; interactive full indexes always background with stale-context cancellation/5-second deadline, tiny bounded literal append reuse only.
Whole text segments normalized before cell rasterization and final painting; embedded child OSC52 remains pending explicit UI mediation.
Unicode format controls are explicit U+ labels, measured after normalization; surrogate values also rendered safely.

Notification queue32, drop-oldest with visible skipped count; one transition hook/publication and grouped alert commands/evaluation, JSON stdin; new session and full process-group TERM/KILL on timeout even if shell exits first.

Sparse populated-cell scrollback extraction, cached immutable ASCII cells and bulk complete-CRLF scroll batches retain exact screen/history/eviction semantics; no fidelity dropped for speed. Canonical implementation now lives under raven.terminal; legacy flat imports alias the same module object.

Shared dependency-free redactor masks identifiers containing credential keys, quoted assignments, complete Authorization values, password flags, token prefixes and URL userinfo; installer also reuses it.
Explicit project/export root resolves legitimate existing symlink once; descendant opens remain pinned/no-follow and newly created export components cannot follow raced symlinks.

Bounded full-source search scans newest window, returns exact searched/unsearched byte ranges, marks global line number unknown; partial initial regex line is excluded rather than inventing ^ boundary.
ASCII fast draw is restricted to printable ASCII; embedded C0 falls through safely while following printable text is retained.
Quiet hours default to local timezone; explicit IANA selection remains validated.

Normal hangup reaches shell and actual foreground groups; no all-session process scan or routine SIGKILL. Explicit nohup/disowned work survives tab close. Canonical implementation now lives under raven.terminal; legacy flat imports alias the same module object.

Broker waits for readiness and real publication/recording/cleanup deadlines; empty broker blocks indefinitely, active idle reaping timer1second. Canonical implementation now lives under raven.terminal; legacy flat imports alias the same module object.

PTY read slice64KiB plus sparse/bulk exact VT handling; read-boundary prefix alignment allows Linux4095-byte reads to batch without losing partial lines. Canonical implementation now lives under raven.terminal; legacy flat imports alias the same module object.

design_tradeoffs: Shared handoff lifecycle avoids separate restoration branches; normal terminal hangup preserves explicit background ownership.
Publication tokens used only for native Store; arbitrary extensions retain conservative invalidation.
Background clipboard/index work reuses existing workers; bounds reject excess ordinary copy requests and coalesce stale notification hooks.
Bulk VT path only accepts complete printable ASCII CRLF lines with compatible normal full-screen state; other input uses VT parser.
Export root ownership validation and pinned no-follow descendants replace ephemeral scheduler-state exports.

integration_followups.alternative_review: Restoring a test-global registry or keeping only the first registration would conceal application-session lifetime leakage and preserve import-order dependence. Per-App ownership fixes live multi-session semantics while retaining direct component support.
